units.source_text: 源氏中将照例到藤壶院参与管弦表演。

en.t: Lieutenant General Genji went as usual to Fujitsubo's residence to take part in the music performance.

units.source_text: 皇上抱了小皇子出来听赏。

en.t: The Emperor came out holding the little prince in his arms to listen and enjoy it.

units.source_text: 他对源氏中将说：“我有许多儿子，只有你一人，从小就和我朝夕相见，就像这个孩子一样。

en.t: He said to Lieutenant General Genji, "I have many sons, but you alone have been with me morning and evening since childhood, just like this child.

units.source_text: 因此我看见他便联想你幼小时候，他实在很像你呢。

en.t: So when I see him, I am reminded of you as a child; he truly resembles you very much.

units.source_text: 难道孩子们幼小时都是这样的么？”

en.t: Can it be that all children are like this when they are small?"

units.source_text: 他这话表示对此两人非常爱怜。

en.t: These words showed how deeply he loved and cherished the two of them.

units.source_text: 源氏中将听了这话，自觉脸上变色。

en.t: Hearing this, Lieutenant General Genji felt the color change in his face.

units.source_text: 心中又恐怖又抱歉，同时又欢喜又怜爱。

en.t: In his heart he felt both fear and remorse, yet at the same time joy and tenderness.

units.source_text: 左思右想，百感交集，几乎掉下泪来。

en.t: As he thought it over from every side, countless feelings welled up together, and he nearly shed tears.

units.source_text: 此时小皇子咿呀学语，笑逐颜开，这般美景，令人爱煞！

en.t: Just then the little prince babbled as if learning to speak, his face breaking into a radiant smile; the lovely sight was irresistibly endearing.

units.source_text: 源氏中将想道：“我既然像他，可知也是这般美丽的。”

en.t: Lieutenant General Genji thought, "If I resemble him, then I too must have been this beautiful."

units.source_text: 便觉自身甚可矜贵，这也未免太过分了。

en.t: He then felt that his own person was exceedingly precious, which was admittedly going too far.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子听了皇上这番话，痛心之极，流下一身冷汗。

en.t: When Lady Fujitsubo heard these words from the Emperor, she was pierced with anguish and broke out in cold sweat all over.

units.source_text: 源氏中将见了这小皇子，心情反而缭乱了，不久告辞退出。

en.t: After seeing the little prince, Lieutenant General Genji's feelings became all the more confused, and before long he took his leave and withdrew.
